exposure: Maternal psychiatric medications (antipsychotics and hypnotics indices)
cohort: The study included 91 maternal and infant dyads whose mothers took psychiatric medications at a hospital between 2010 and 2019.
finding: Models were developed using neonatal head circumference z-scores, Apgar scores at 5 min < 9, and maternal antipsychotic and hypnotic drug indices, which accurately predicted the onset of nonopiate-induced NAS.
